## Description

Please describe the changes in this pull request and link any related issues.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring or performance improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the repository's style and architecture guidelines
- [ ] I have executed `pnpm lint` and resolved all warnings/errors
- [ ] I have executed `pnpm exec next typegen && pnpm typecheck` with zero errors
- [ ] If changing database schema, I have run migrations and updated relevant queries
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] Any dependent documentation has been updated accordingly
